name: product-landing
title: Product page (landing)
description: Product landing sections with capability cards, workflow cards, code examples, steps, related products, and an FAQ.
usage: The product pages. Scrape, Map, Batches, Monitors, Answers, Brand and Style guide open with the site's Hero; Parse, Brand search, People enrichment, News and the ChatGPT page open with the white ProductHero (its demo as children). Then LogoStrip, ProductStorySection (capabilities), ProductIntegration (`playgroundHref` adds the playground pill beside the API reference), ProductStorySection columns={2} (workflows), ProductLandingSteps (three numbered steps), ProductFaq, ProductRelatedCards (two related products), and close with ClosingCta. The alternatives pages reuse ProductFaq; the use case pages build their API example on ProductIntegration.
avoid: Cards without the soft blue ring
A black pill in the code section (the docs and playground links are outline pills)
An arrow that moves when a related product card is hovered
More than three steps in ProductLandingSteps

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
